seed: measure-redline success item 4: someone used to CleanShot X or Shottr gets from a capture to a redline on the clipboard in no more steps than there. This walk is the count for Photonz, at Next defaults with no flag touched, and every step a person takes is one numbered step here: (1) Shift Command 4, (2) the drag on the frozen screen, (3) Shift Command 6 to open it, (4) I for Measure, (5) I again for Size, (6) a click on the button, (7) I for Gap, because after a Size or Gap click the Measure tool stays in hand (the user's answer on 2026-10-11; until then a landed measurement handed back to Select and this was ten steps), (8) a click in the space between the cards, (9) Shift Command C. Nine, level with Shottr's nine. A walk cannot put the capture overlay over the person's screen, so step 1 goes through the dispatcher the global hotkey calls (the stand-in stops short of the overlay) and step 2 is a lent capture with its toast, which is what the drag ends in. The table is in docs/design/next-measure.md, section 13.
